uncharacterizedLocalTestFlake.detail: One local full-suite run reported a single failure whose identity was not captured before the output scrolled. Two subsequent local runs and ordinary CI were clean.

amendment5.note: Amendment 5's closures stand. Amendment 6 fixes two execution blockers it introduced or left, and unifies contracts it left inconsistent.

stage1ContractManifestAggregate.why: The aggregate covers every governed file. Writing it into a file the manifest itself hashes would be self-referential.

executionBlockersClosed.defect: Amendment 5's closed schema declared six AnalyzerOcrConfidence keys; production emits seven, including a required missingTokenCount. Every real candidate would have been rejected as carrying an unexpected key.
executionBlockersClosed.whyCiStayedGreen: The synthetic tests and the hard-coded drift guard repeated the same wrong list.
executionBlockersClosed.fix: missingTokenCount added everywhere, with arithmetic invariants; a production-compatibility test drives the real selector and finalizes actual emitted candidates through one reference adapter; the drift guard is rebuilt on typed exemplars and real selector output.

executionBlockersClosed.defect: The closure gate rejected every transitive dependency under src/domain/rules/**, but field-selection.ts imports @/domain/rules/wine-alcohol-parse on line 1. Trusted preparation would have halted while bundling the incumbent.
executionBlockersClosed.fix: one frozen path-and-hash exception; every other rules module stays prohibited

forbiddenEvidenceKeyInventory.priorDefect: Three different sets were in play — ten keys, seven keys and five keys — so brandPresent, historicalCaseId and historicalImagePath were absent from the executable emitted-field scanner.

corrections: AnalyzerOcrConfidence corrected to seven fields with enforced arithmetic invariants
a single reference candidate adapter, required for Stage 2 and tested against real selector output
the production drift guard rebuilt on typed exemplars instead of asserted key lists
one frozen path-and-hash exception for the incumbent's mandatory wine-alcohol-parse dependency, plus a production-source base-drift gate
one authoritative ten-key forbidden-evidence inventory, held in a canonical asset and governing every emitted file
the ID-map readable-only-after rule replaced with accurate staging, mounting and authorization controls
the Stage 2 workflow frozen as three separate jobs, with Job A trusted rather than the workflow being called truth-free
a clean Job C identity-leak report made a mandatory precondition for both commitment and evaluation
the bundle scanner's source-text inference replaced with a canonical inventory asset and a raw-byte scan covering binary files
stale statements corrected: the recognizer claim, the actor-3 access claim, the before-truth-is-loaded framing, and git-sha.txt
unchangedByThisAmendment: the frozen 115-item population and its opaque identifiers
the incumbent configuration pins, including field-selection.ts 8e05462a86449c5e7cd91993e213ed0447a2389aae6bd3216cefd1b4e895e79c
two exact corpus runs with no retries and no selective rerun
the direct extractLabelEvidenceDetailed route and the runCaseArtifacts prohibition
